assertions.name: literal_is_z3_at_the_muon_anchor
assertions.source: z_3 = q^3/[3]_q evaluated at the CODATA-2022 muon anchor reproduces the warned-about literal to the literal's own precision. This is the identification the published warning gets wrong.

assertions.name: literal_is_NOT_h_q_by_a_factor_of_two
assertions.source: |h_q - literal|/literal = 0.534702749674541602711107937368175882518504263919587166335642 -- h_q = q - 1/q is 0.209060298795639315430846213129674943859757495263063078255215, roughly half the literal. The claim that they 'differ at the 8th decimal' is not a small error in a true statement; the quantities are not comparable.

description: Bean qou-yk03. The corpus's documented grep warning -- 'the literal 0.44930482320583087 in many witnesses is h_q, NOT z_3 (0.449304809090...)' -- misnames the quantity. Measured at 65 dps, that literal is z_3 = q^3/[3]_q at the MUON anchor (rel 2.17e-10, which is the literal's own 17-digit truncation), while h_q = q - 1/q is 53 % away. So the two numbers are not two quantities that resemble each other; they are ONE quantity at the two substrate anchors, and the 3.14e-8 gap is the mu-p tension propagated through z_3. That matters because the note as written tells an agent a muon-pinned value needs no anchor check, inverting the 2026-08-07 proton-by-default directive. EXTENT IS SMALL and is reported as measured: 5 files carry the literal, 3 under _deprecated/ and 2 being the doc and bean that carry the misidentification itself -- ZERO live producers. A documentation correction, not a drain. Does NOT claim any computed result is wrong.

candidate_identification.note: The muon row's 2.17e-10 residual is the literal's own truncation at 17 significant digits, not a mismatch. h_q is not a near miss -- it is off by a factor of two.

anchor_gap.note: 3.14e-8 -- the mu-p substrate tension (~11.6 ppb on q) propagated through z_3 and amplified ~2.7x. This is the real content of the 'differ at the 8th decimal' observation: a LAYER STRADDLE, which AGENTS.md calls a defect regardless of size, not a coincidental lookalike.

q0AnchorReason: comparison by design: evaluates z_3 = q^3/[3]_q and h_q at both the proton pin (Q_50_DIGIT_STR) and the live CODATA-2022 muon pin to identify which anchor a recorded literal was computed at
